reflections: Faye is proactive and flexible, offering coordination and adapting around constraints.

events.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and where do you need me?
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Uli: Thank you, Faye. It’s Saturday at 10, over by my garage if that works for you.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 by your garage works for me—I’ll plan around the school schedule and be there.

events.text: Pia: Great, Saturday at 10 by your garage works for me. I’ll bring what tools I have and keep an eye out for your update if anything changes.

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia. I really appreciate it—I'll let you know if anything changes.
